Which of the following series are convergent?

1. $∑_(n = 1)^(∞)\frac{1}{n\sqrt{n}}$
2. $∑_(n = 1)^(∞)\frac{3}{n}$
3. $∑_(n = 1)^(∞)\frac{\sqrt{n}}{2n^{3}}$

Which of the following series are convergent?

1. $∑_(n = 1)^(∞)\frac{3}{n^{5}}$
2. $∑_(n = 1)^(∞)\frac{5}{n^{3}\sqrt{n}}$
3. $∑_(n = 1)^(∞)\frac{\sqrt{n^{3}}}{n^{2}}$

Which of the following series are convergent?

I. - ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{2}{n\sqrt[3]{{n}^{2}}}$
II. - ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{1}{3{n}^{4}}$
III. - ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{5\sqrt[3]{n}}{\sqrt{n}}$

Which of the following series are convergent?

I. - ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{3n}{\sqrt[4]{{n}^{5}}}$
II. - ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{5}{4{n}^{3}}$
III. - ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{\sqrt{n}}{\sqrt[5]{{n}^{3}}}$

Which of the following series are convergent?

I. - ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{4}{{n}^{2}}$
II. - ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{\sqrt{3}}{{n}^{5}}$
III. - ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{n\sqrt[3]{n}}{\sqrt[4]{{n}^{7}}}$

Which of the following series are convergent?

I. - ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{1}{n\sqrt{{n}^{3}}}$
II. - ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{8}{\sqrt[9]{{n}^{2}}}$
III. - ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{\sqrt{{n}^{3}}}{2{n}^{2}}$

Which of the following series converge?

I. - ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{1}{\sqrt{{n}^{3}}}$
II. - ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{1}{2\sqrt[4]{{n}^{5}}}$
III. - ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{n}{\sqrt{{n}^{3}}}$

Which of the following series are convergent?

I. - ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{1}{n}$
II. - ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{1}{{n}^{3}}$
III. - ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{3}{\sqrt[3]{{n}^{7}}}$

Which of the following series are convergent?

I. - ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{1}{4n}$
II. - ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{1}{{n}^{2}\sqrt{n}}$
III. - ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{2}{3{n}^{5}}$
